sites.name: Tarangire National Park
sites.summary: Baobab-studded woodlands and the life-giving Tarangire River – one of East Africa’s great dry-season birding and wildlife parks.
whyItMatters: World-famous day-list potential – more than 550 species recorded in the ecosystem.
Only Tanzanian stronghold for Yellow-collared Lovebird and Ashy Starling in the north.
Acacia–baobab mosaic is ideal for lovebirds, weavers, barbets and photographic savanna birding.
sites.generalNotes: Standard northern birding stop on 10-day and 15-day Endemic Birds itineraries.

sites.name: Serengeti National Park
sites.summary: Endless plains and iconic savanna – raptors, grassland specialists and migration spectacle alongside classic northern birding routes.
whyItMatters: Globally recognised savanna ecosystem with exceptional raptor and bustard viewing.
Migration season adds density and predator action – complementary to specialist forest days elsewhere.
Pairs with Ngorongoro and Tarangire on combined wildlife-and-birding northern safaris.
sites.generalNotes: Birding-focused departures target kopjes, river lines and woodland ecotones – not only big-game loops.
